name: Sylvie Hardland
original_name: シルフィー・ハードランド
source:
The princess of Hardland. She doesn't agree with her father's way of ruling and wants to change her country's future. She is betrothed to Bruno, but has feelings for Georik.

"...hides an iron will under heaving bosoms and about two square miles of pink taffeta. [spoiler]Also, she has a secret identity that's kind of a spoiler, but I wish we'd seen more of it, because oh my god thigh-high lace up boots I AM WIPING THE DROOL OFF MY KEYBOARD.[/spoiler]"

[Based on [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061018090801/http://community.hirameki-int.com/modules/charpoll5/index.php?id=1]Hirameki's Official Site[/url] (Website is via webarchive)]
